OPERATIVE NOTE (template: procedures - dental / oral) Gentle Hands Family Dentistry Chart #GH-55120 Patient name: Marcus Elias Wren DOB: 11/02/2050 Procedure date: 03/19/2076 Surgeon: Dr. Hamish Grieve, DDS Assistant: Ruth Ellery RDH Preoperative diagnosis: Gingivitis, generalised, with calculus Postoperative diagnosis: Same Procedure: Oral exam, bitewing radiographs, supragingival and subgingival scaling all quadrants, oral hygiene instruction. Anesthesia: Topical only. Pt tolerated well. Findings: Heavy calculus lower anteriors, bleeding on probing throughout, probing depths 3-4 mm, no mobility, no abscess. Two small areas of early decay noted to be watched. Description: after verbal consent the patient was seated and the area was prep and draped.... The ultrasonic scaler was used for the supragingival deposits then hand instruments for subgingival, all four quadrants. Irrigated with chlorhexidine. Hemostasis ok. Pt was given a new brush and floss and shown technique, his wife Tamsin was present for the teaching because she "does the flossing for both of us". Complications: none. Estimated blood loss: minimal. Disposition: home. Recall 6 mos. Letter to ED coordinator Linda Szabo - done. Note: Pt reports hes doing better, drinking "almost nothing", job interview went ok. Update the med list: no meds.
Dictated by Hamish Grieve DDS 03/19/2076 Transcribed by Ruth Ellery - not proofed Referred by: Priyanka Venkataraghavan / ED Care Coordination
